name: askmywa
description: Read, search and send your WhatsApp messages from Claude on Mac and Windows. Nothing is sent without your approval.
long_description:
Links to your personal WhatsApp account as a linked device, like WhatsApp Web, and keeps a private archive of your messages on this computer. Claude can search it, read conversations, save attachments and, after showing you a preview you approve, send messages, files and voice notes.

To start, ask Claude to connect WhatsApp: it asks for your phone number and gives you a code to type in WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link with phone number.

This uses an unofficial WhatsApp interface. Your messages stay on your computer and only reach Claude when it calls a tool.

send_folder.title: Folder for files to send
send_folder.description: Claude can only send files that are inside this folder. Put a file here, then ask Claude to send it.
